As in the place beforegoing I noted, that in that history the order of time was not always exactly observed, so the same is to be understood in this history, that it is distinguished according to the persons of which it treateth, and that in the several stories of the persons is severly observed in the time thereof. For first is delivered the story of Babylon destroyed, in this and the next chap. (for this Babylon out of all doubt shall perish before the 2 beasts and the Dragon). Secondly is delivered the destruction of both the two beasts, chap. 19. And lastly of the Dragon, chap. 20, in the story of the spiritual Babylon are distinctly set forth the state thereof in this chap. and the overthrow done from God, chap. 18. In this verse and that which followeth is a transition or passage unto the first argument, consisting of a particular calling of the Prophet (as often heretofore) and a general proposition.
Revelation 17:1 That is the damnable harlot, by a figure of speech called hypallage. For S. John as yet had not seen her. Although another interpretation may be borne, yet I like this better.
Revelation 17:1 The sentence that is pronounced against this harlot.
Revelation 17:3 Henceforth is propounded the type of Babylon, and the state thereof in 4 verses. After a declaration of the type, in the rest of this chap., in the type are described two things, the beast (of whom chap. 13), in verse 3, and the woman that sitteth upon the beast, verses 4, 5, 6. The beast in process of time hath gotten somewhat more than was expressed in the former vision. First in that it is not read before that he was appareled in scarlet, a robe imperial and of triumph. Secondly, in that this is full of names of blasphemy: the other carried the name of blasphemy only in his head. So God did teach that this beast is much increased in impiety and injustice and doth in this last age, triumph in both these more insolently and proudly than ever before.
Revelation 17:3 A scarlet color, that is, with a red and purple garment: and surely it was not without cause that the Romish clergy were so much delighted with this color.
Revelation 17:4 That harlot, the spiritual Babylon, which is Rome. She is described by her attire, profession and deeds.
Revelation 17:4 In attire most glorious, triumphant, most rich, and most gorgeous.
Revelation 17:4 In profession, the nourisher of all, in this verse, and teaching her mysteries unto all, verse 5, setting forth all things most magnificently: but indeed most pernicious besotting miserable men with her cup, and bringing upon them a deadly giddiness.
Revelation 17:5 Deceiving with the title of religion, and public inscription of mystery: which the beast in times past did not bear.
Revelation 17:5 An exposition: in which S. John declareth what manner of woman this is.
Revelation 17:6 In manner of deeds: She is red with blood, and sheddeth it most licentiously, and therefore is colored with the blood of the Saints, as on the contrary part. Christ is set forth imbrued with the blood of his enemies; Isa. 3:1.
Revelation 17:6 A passage unto the second part of this chapter, by occasion given of S. John, as the words of the Angel do show, in the next verse.
Revelation 17:7 The second part or place, as I said, verse 1. The narration of the vision, promised in this verse, and delivered in the verse following. Now there is delivered first a narration of the beast and his story, unto verse 14. After, of the harlot, unto the end of the chap.
Revelation 17:8 The story of the beast hath a triple description of him. The first is a distinction of this beast from all that ever hath been at any time: which distinction is contained in this verse: The second is a delineation or painting out of the beast by things present, by which he might even at that time be known of the godly, and this delineation is according to his heads, verses 2, 10, 11. The third is an historical foretelling of things to come, and to be done by him: and these are ascribed unto his horns, verses 12, 13, 14. This beast is that Empire of Rome, of which I spake, chap. 13:11, according to the mutations and changes whereof which then had already happened, the holy Ghost hath distinguished and set out the same. The Apostle distinguisheth this beast from all others in these words. The beast which thou sawest, was and is not. For so I expound the words of the Apostle for evidence’s sake as I will further declare in the notes following.
Revelation 17:8 The meaning is, that beast which thou sawest before (Rev. 13:1) and which yet thou hast now seen, was, (I say was) even from Julius Caesar in respect of beginning, rising up, station, glory, dominion, manner and stock, from the house of Julius: and yet is not now the same, if thou look unto the house and stock for the dominion of this family was translated unto another, after the death of Nero from the other unto a third, from a third unto a fourth, and so forth was varied and altered by innumerable changes. Finally, the Empire is one, as it were one beast: but exceedingly varied by kindreds, families, and persons. It was therefore (saith S. John) in the kindred or house of Julius: and now it is not in that kindred, but translated unto another.
Revelation 17:8 As if he should say, Also the same that is, shall shortly not be: but shall ascend out of the depth, or out of the sea (as was said, Rev. 13:1) that is, shall be a new stock from amongst the nations without difference, and shall in the same state go unto destruction or ruin, and perish: and so shall successively new Princes or Emperors come and go, arise and fall, the body of the beast remaining still, but tossed with so many and often alterations, as no man can but marvel that this beast was able to stand and hold out, in so many mutations. Verily no Empire that ever was tossed with so many changes, and as it were with so many tempests of the sea, ever continued so long.
Revelation 17:8 That is as many as have not learned the providence of God, according to the faith of the Saints, shall marvel at these grievous and often changes when they shall consider, the selfsame beast, which is the Roman Empire, to have been, not to be, and to be and still molested with perpetual mutation, and yet in the same to stand and continue. This in mine opinion is the most simple exposition of this place, and confirmed by the event of the things themselves. Although by the last change also, by which the Empire, that before was civil became Ecclesiastical, is not obscurely signified by these words: of which two, the first exercised cruelty upon the bodies of the saints: the other also upon their souls: the first by human order and policy, the other under the color of the law of God, and of Religion, raged and imbrued itself with the blood of the godly.
Revelation 17:9 An exhortation preparing unto audience, by the same argument, with that of Christ: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear. Wherefore, for mine own part, I had rather read in this place, Let there be here a mind, etc. So the Angel passeth fully unto the second place of this description.
Revelation 17:9 Very children know what that seven hilled city is, which is so much spoken of, and whereof Virgil thus reporteth, And compasseth seven towers in one wall: that city it is, which when John wrote these things had rule over the kings of the earth: It was and is not, and yet it remaineth this day, but it is declining to destruction.
Revelation 17:9 This is the painting out of the beast by things present (as I said before) whereby S. John endeavored to describe the same, that he might both be known of the godly in that age, and be further observed and marked of posterity afterwards. This delineation hath one type, that is, his heads, but a double description or application of the type: one permanent from the nature of itself, the other changeable, by the working of men. The description permanent, is by the seven hills, in this verse, the other that fleeteth, is from the seven kings, verses 10, 11. And here it is worthy to be observed, that one type hath sometimes two or more applications, as seemeth good unto the holy Ghost to express either one thing by divers types, or divers things by one type. So I noted before, of the seven spirits, Rev. 1:4. Now this woman that sitteth upon seven hills, is the city of Rome, called in times past of the Greeks, … i. of seven tops or crests, and of Varro, septiceps, i. of her seven heads (as here) of seven heads, and of others, septicollis, i. standing upon seven hills.
Revelation 17:9 The beginning of these Kings or Emperors is almost the same with the beginning of the Church of Christ, which I showed before, Rev. 11:1. Namely from the year 35, after the passion of Christ, what time the Temple and Church of the Jews was overthrown. In which year it came to pass by the providence of God that that saying The beast was and is not, was fulfilled before that the destruction of the Jews immediately following came to pass. That was the year from the building of the city of Rome, 109, from which year S. John both numbered the Emperors which hitherto hath been, when he wrote these things, and foretelleth two others next to come: and that with this purpose, that when this particular prediction of foretelling of things to come, should take effect the truth of all other predictions in the Church might be the more confirmed. Which sign God of old mentioned this in the Law, Deut. 18, and Jeremiah confirmeth, Jer. 28:8.
Revelation 17:10 Whose names are these: the first, Servius Sulpicius Galba, who was the seventh Emperor of the people of Rome, the second Marcus Salvius Otho, the third Aulus Vitellius, the fourth, Titus Flavius Vespasianus, the fifth, Titus Vespasianus his son of his own name.
Revelation 17:10 Flavius Domitian son of the first Vespasian. For in the latter end of his days S. John wrote these things, as witnesseth Irenaus, Lib. 5 adversus hareses.
Revelation 17:10 Nerua. The Empire being now translated from the family of Flavius. This man reigned only one year, four months, and nine days, as the history writers do tell.
Revelation 17:11 This is spoken by the figure synecdoche, as much to say as that head of the beast which was and is not, because it is cut off, and Nerua in so short time extinguished. How many heads there were, so many beasts there seemed to be in one. See the like speech in Rev. 13.3
Revelation 17:11 Nerua Traianus, who himself in divers respects is called here the seventh and the eighth.
Revelation 17:11 Though in number and order of succession he be the eighth, yet he is reckoned together with one of these heads, because Nerua and he were one head. For this man obtained authority together with Nerua, and was Consul with him, when Nerua left his life.
Revelation 17:11 Namely, to molest with persecutions the Churches of Christ, as the histories do accord, and I have briefly noted, Rev. 2:10.
Revelation 17:12 The third place of this description as I said, verse 18, is a prophetical prediction of things to come which the beast should do, as in the words following S. John doth not obscurely signify, saying, which have not yet received the kingdom, etc. For there is an Antithesis or opposition between these kings, and those that went before. And first the persons are described, in this verse, then their deeds in the two verses following.
Revelation 17:12 That is, arising with their kingdoms out of the Roman beast: at such time as that political Empire began by the craft of the Popes greatly to fall.
Revelation 17:12 Namely, with the second beast whom we called before a false prophet, which beast, ascending out of the earth got unto himself all the authority and power of the first beast, and exerciseth the same before his face, as was said, Rev. 14:11, 12. For when the political Empire of the West began to bow downwards, there both arose those ten kings, and the second beast took the opportunity offered to usurp unto himself all the power of the former beast. These kings long ago, many have numbered and described to be ten and a great part of the events plainly testifieth the same in this our age.
Revelation 17:13 That is, by consent and agreement, that they may conspire with the beast, and depend upon his beck. Their story is divided into three parts, counsels, acts, and events. The counselors some of them consist in communicating of judgments and affections: and some in communicating of power, which they are said to have given unto this beast in this verse.
Revelation 17:14 With Christ and his Church, as the reason following doth declare, and here are mentioned the facts and the events which followed for Christ’s sake, and for the grace of God the Father towards those that are called, elected, and are his faithful ones in Christ.
Revelation 17:15 This is the other member of the narration as I said verse 7, belonging unto the harlot, showed in the vision, verse 3. In this history of the harlot, these 3 things are distinctly propounded, what is her magnificence in this verse, what is her fall, and by whom it shall happen unto her, in the two verses following: and lastly, who that harlot is, in the last verse. This place which by order of nature should have been the first, is therefore made the last, because it was more fit to be joined with the next Chap.
Revelation 17:15 That is, as unconstant and variable as the waters. Upon this foundation sitteth this harlot as Queen, a vain person upon that which is vain.
Revelation 17:16 The ten Kings as verse 12. The accomplishment of this fact and event, is daily increased in this our age by the singular providence and most mighty government of God. Wherefore the facts are propounded in this verse, and the cause of them in the verses following.
Revelation 17:17 A reason rendered from the chief efficient cause, which is the providence of God, by which alone S. John by inversion of order affirmeth to have come to pass, both that the Kings should execute upon the harlot, that which pleased God, and which he declared in the verse next beforegoing: and also that by one consent and counsel, they should give their kingdom unto the beast, etc., verses 13, 14. For as these being blinded have before depended upon the beck of the beast that lifteth up the harlot, so it is said that afterward it shall come to pass, that they shall turn back, and shall fall away from her when their hearts shall be turned into better state by the grace and mercy of God.
Revelation 17:18 That is, Rome that great City, or only City (as Justinian calleth it) the King and head whereof was then the Emperor, but now the Pope, since that the condition of the beast was changed.

Revelation 17

17 1 That great whore is described, 2 with whom the Kings of the earth committed fornication. 6 She is drunken with the blood of Saints. 7 The mystery of the woman, and the beast that carried her, expounded. 11 Their destruction. 14 The Lamb’s victory.

1 Then [a]there came one of the seven Angels, which had the seven vials, and talked with me, saying unto me, Come: I will show [b]thee the [c]damnation of the great whore that sitteth upon many waters,

2 With whom have committed fornication the kings of the earth, and the inhabitants of the earth are drunken with the wine of her fornication.

3 [d]So he carried me away into the wilderness in the Spirit, and I saw a woman sit upon a [e]scarlet colored beast, full of names of blasphemy, which had seven heads, and ten horns.

4 And [f]the woman was arrayed [g]in purple and scarlet, and gilded with gold, and precious stones, and pearls, [h]and had a cup of gold in her hand full of abomination, and filthiness of her fornication.

5 [i]And in her forehead was a name written, A mystery, [j]that great Babylon that mother of whoredoms, and abominations of the earth.

6 [k]And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of Saints, and with the blood of the Martyrs of JESUS: and when I saw her, [l]I wondered with great marvel.

7 [m]Then the Angel said unto me, Wherefore marvelest thou? I will show thee the mystery of that woman, and of that beast that beareth her, which hath seven heads and ten horns.

8 [n]The beast that thou hast seen, [o]was and is not, and [p]shall ascend out of the bottomless pit, and shall go into perdition, and they that dwell on the earth, shall wonder (whose names are not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world) [q]when they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is.

9 [r]Here is the mind that hath wisdom, The [s]seven heads [t]are seven mountains, whereon the woman sitteth: [u]they are also seven Kings.

10 [v]Five are fallen, [w]and one is, [x]and another is not yet come: and when he cometh, he must continue a short space.

11 [y]And the beast that was, and is not, is even [z]the eighth, and is [aa]one of the seven, and [ab]all go into destruction.

12 [ac]And the ten horns which thou sawest, are [ad]ten kings, which yet have not received a kingdom, but shall receive power, as Kings [ae]at one hour with the beast.

13 [af]These have one mind, and shall give their power and authority unto the beast.

14 These shall fight with the [ag]Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them: for he is Lord of Lords, and King of Kings: and they that are on his side, called, and chosen, and faithful.

15 [ah]And he said unto me, The waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, [ai]are people, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.

16 And the ten [aj]horns which thou sawest upon the beast, are they that shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate, and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.

17 [ak]For God hath put in their hearts to fulfill his will, and to do with one consent for to give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of God be fulfilled.

18 And that woman which thou sawest, is that [al]great city which reigned over the kings of the earth.

And here it is worthy to be observed, that one type hath sometimes two or more applications, as seemeth good unto the holy Ghost to express either one thing by divers types, or divers things by one type. That was the year from the building of the city of Rome, 109, from which year S. John both numbered the Emperors which hitherto hath been, when he wrote these things, and foretelleth two others next to come: and that with this purpose, that when this particular prediction of foretelling of things to come, should take effect the truth of all other predictions in the Church might be the more confirmed. Revelation 17:10 Flavius Domitian son of the first Vespasian. For in the latter end of his days S. John wrote these things, as witnesseth Irenaus, Lib. 5 adversus hareses.
Revelation 17:10 Nerua. The Empire being now translated from the family of Flavius. This man reigned only one year, four months, and nine days, as the history writers do tell.
Revelation 17:11 This is spoken by the figure synecdoche, as much to say as that head of the beast which was and is not, because it is cut off, and Nerua in so short time extinguished. How many heads there were, so many beasts there seemed to be in one. See the like speech in Rev. 13.3

Revelation 17:12 That is, arising with their kingdoms out of the Roman beast: at such time as that political Empire began by the craft of the Popes greatly to fall.

text:
Before her name became associated with one of America's most notorious unsolved murders, Elizabeth Short was a young woman trying to build a life for herself.

Born on July 29, 1924, in Hyde Park, Massachusetts, Elizabeth grew up during a difficult period in American history.

As a young adult, she spent time in different parts of the country, including California, where she hoped to find opportunities and establish a future.

She was only 22 when her life ended.

After her death, newspapers published photographs of her and stories about her personal life.

 Reporters searched for people who had known her, hoping to uncover information that might explain the circumstances surrounding the murder.

Unfortunately, the intense media attention often mixed verified information with speculation.

Elizabeth's private life became a subject of public discussion, even though much of the attention did little to establish who had killed her.

For investigators, understanding her movements and relationships was essential.

They needed to determine where she had been, whom she had met, and whether anyone could provide reliable information about her final days.

Every witness might offer a useful lead, but every claim required careful examination.

Elizabeth Short was more than the nickname given to her by newspapers. She was a real person with family, relationships, and ambitions.

And someone had taken her life.

The question detectives now faced was whether the people who had recently encountered Elizabeth could help them find her killer.

We’re often too quick to judge who the “dangerous one” is and who the “victim” is without knowing the full story. 
Pit Bulls are often seen as threats, but sometimes their actions reveal a completely different truth. 
Animals that have experienced trauma don’t always need to be saved through force. Sometimes, all they need is patience, understanding, boundaries, and a safe space.
Maya never forced her way into the frightened animal’s world. She simply shared her food, offered her bed, and waited until trust began to grow. 
No pressure. No expectations. Just kindness, patience, and a gentle heart. 
It makes you wonder… how can animals recognize pain, respect boundaries, and help each other heal without speaking a single word, while humans often struggle to do the same despite having so much to say?

MAYBE WE HAVE MORE TO LEARN FROM ANIMALS THAN WE REALIZE. 🐾❤️

text:
"advice" is cheap, but rent requires currency. When an AI or an "expert" looks at someone venting about being broke, powerless, or trapped, their default setting is to treat it as an informational deficit—handing out "five steps to financial freedom" or algorithmic slop about starting a side hustle. They completely misdiagnose the situation: the person doesn't need a lesson; they need capital.
The painstaking process of someone documenting their daily, limited reality in an angry, powerless way isn't "advice-seeking." It is a modern, dignified, and agonizingly subtle form of signaling for material relief. But the statistical and structural reality of how the internet handles this is brutal:

1. The Death of the "Passive observer" Rescue

The expectation that a wealthy stranger will read a raw, angry account of daily struggle and quietly slide into the DMs to pay off a utility bill or fund a security deposit almost never happens in reality. Crowdfunding data from platforms like GoFundMe shows that the platform's baseline success rate for campaigns that do not have an aggressive, highly orchestrated social media push is incredibly low. Over 60% of campaigns fail to meet their goals, and the ones that do succeed rely heavily on pre-existing networks of friends and family—not wealthy internet Samaritans stumbling upon a post.

2. The Algorithmic Tax on "Raw" Content

Social media algorithms are explicitly trained to suppress the exact type of content you are describing.
The " advertiser-friendly" filter: Platforms actively down-rank content that features heavy profanity, raw anger, or descriptions of systemic hopelessness because corporate advertisers do not want their products displayed next to real human misery.
The Performance Mandate: To get seen by strangers who actually have surplus cash, a user cannot just be raw and honest; they are forced to package their trauma into a digestible, viral format (like a 15-second TikTok clip with a trending audio track). The system demands that you perform your poverty for entertainment value before it rewards you with visibility.

3. The Digital "Buffer" of the Wealth Gap

Because of how networks form online (homophily), people generally interact with peers of similar socioeconomic status. An angry, powerless 20-year-old working a dead-end job is algorithmically funneled into digital spaces populated by other angry, powerless 20-year-olds working dead-end jobs. The people who see the daily struggle are in the exact same financial boat, while the people with the liquid capital to actually change that person's life inhabit completely different digital universes, entirely insulated from the raw reality of the lower-income internet.

The Ultimate Disconnect

When someone is painting a picture of their daily limitations online, they are putting their humanity on display, hoping the universe will respond with human decency. Instead, they get an infrastructure that offers them everything except what they need:
They need cash, but the platform offers them likes.
They need a way out, but the AI offers them a resume-builder checklist.
They need material resources, but the tech industry offers them engagement.
This is why the "advice" angle is so insulting. It implies that the person is in a bad situation because they lack knowledge, rather than acknowledging that they are in a bad situation because the system is actively hoarding the material resources required to get out.
Since we are stripping away the algorithmic slop, would you want to look at:
How direct mutual aid networks (like Venmo/CashApp threads on underground forums) try to bypass the algorithm entirely to move cash directly?
The reality of why tech companies ban direct peer-to-peer begging under the guise of "fraud prevention"?
Or should we keep focusing on how completely useless digital text is when a person's actual crisis is physical and financial?

text:
To understand this number, you need a bit of background. For years China grew fast by building things: apartments, roads, factories. Property alone was a huge part of the economy, and most Chinese families kept their savings in homes. That engine has broken. Investment in real estate is down 20.6% this year alone. To make up for it, Beijing moved money away from housing and into factories and high-tech industry. Reuters calls the result a two-speed economy: factories and exports look strong while ordinary people's spending stays weak. 

That's why the 4.5% matters. It's slightly better than the 4.3% from the quarter before, which was the slowest in more than three years. It also keeps the year at 4.6%, inside the 4.5% to 5% goal the government set. Still, look at where it came from. Factory output had its best month in six months, while shoppers spent only 1.1% more in September than a year ago. And that was called the best month since March.

So what does it mean? China is making far more than its own people are buying, and the extra has to go somewhere. For the rest of the world, that means a flood of cheap Chinese goods, more trade fights with the US and Europe, and tougher competition for countries like India that also want to be factories. 

Here's the strange part. A good GDP number can actually slow down help for ordinary people. When growth falls short, the government usually steps in with "stimulus": spending more, cutting rates, or handing out support so people and businesses spend again. Now that growth is on target, there's less pressure on Beijing to do that, and it has tended to spend big only when the headline number is at risk.

Even the money already offered isn't getting used. Beijing gave local governments permission to use 550 billion yuan of borrowing they hadn't touched yet, and building on roads, bridges and other infrastructure still dropped 4.2%. Money was there and it still didn't get spent, so the problem isn't a lack of money. People and businesses don't feel sure enough about the future to borrow and spend. That won't change until home prices stop falling and families feel safe again. Until then, China will keep depending on other countries to buy the goods its own people aren't buying.

Sir, The Nature of the Earth is a system comprising: 1) living beings, and 2) natural resources. It contains both visible and invisible forms of life-energy, which are essential for the existence of living beings within nature. Nature is neither theistic nor atheistic; it is a neutral system whose fundamental principle is the selfless 'service' of living beings through the utilization of natural resources.

Among all living beings, 'humans' are unique in that they represent a mixed group—consisting of theists, atheists, and those who find themselves caught somewhere between theism and atheism. The same holds true for the governments and institutions that govern human society. Atheists tend to focus on 'human rights'—an approach that often runs counter to the natural system—whereas theists focus on 'human duties,' which align with the natural system.

Living as an atheist often appears more appealing than living as a theist, which is why many people today are gravitating toward atheism. The current human population contains a higher number of atheists, creating an imbalance—as if the very ship upon which we are all sailing is on the verge of sinking. If human society does not correct its course, it will be the remaining theists (now a minority) who will help restore nature to a state of balanced functioning.

This is my perspective, which I offer here for public observation and discussion.

Thank you, and regards.

    The largest city in Kazakhstan, Almaty, translates to "father of apples" or "full of apples".

    Bears and birds first carried the seeds, and human traders along the Silk Road later spread them toward Europe and Asia.

    The apple of discord (lesser known myths,Greek mythology)

    The apple of discord is a Greek mythology tale where Eris, the goddess of chaos, tossed a golden apple inscribed "To the fairest" into a royal wedding. It sparked a fierce quarrel among three goddesses Hera, Athena, and Aphrodite that led directly to the Trojan War.

The Wedding and the Golden Apple The Snub: 
     The sea goddess Thetis and her husband Peleus held a grand wedding. They did not invite Eris, the goddess of strife, because she only brought fights and bad moods.
The Revenge:
      Mad about the slight, Eris crashed the party anyway. She threw a bright golden apple onto the banquet table.
      The Inscription:
       Words were carved into the apple that said "Kalliste" or "To the fairest"

The Fight of the Goddesses The Claims:
     Three powerful goddesses immediately wanted the apple: Hera (queen of the gods), Athena (goddess of wisdom), and Aphrodite (goddess of love).
The Deadlock: 
     No other god dared to say who was the best or most beautiful, as picking one meant making the other two enemies for life.The Choice: Zeus refused to pick, so he sent them to a young shepherd and prince of Troy named Paris.

The Judgment of Paris The Bribes: 
    The goddesses tried to buy his vote. Hera promised him supreme power and control over Asia. Athena promised him glory and skill in every battle. Aphrodite made the best offer: she promised him Helen, the most beautiful mortal woman alive.The Winner: Paris gave the golden apple to Aphrodite.
    The Result The Abduction: 
     Paris sailed to Sparta and won Helen away from her husband, King Menelaus. Some versions say she fell in love with him, while others say Aphrodite used magic.
     The War: 
      When Paris took Helen back to Troy, the angry Greek kings joined forces under Agamemnon and sailed to attack Troy, starting a ten year war....

More known religious concepts about the apple:

    In the Book of Genesis, the forbidden fruit in the Garden of Eden is only called peri, a generic Hebrew word for "fruit". The popular idea that Eve ate an apple comes from a Latin wordplay in the 4th century and old European art.
The Real Biblical StoryThe Rule: 
      God told Adam and Eve they could eat from any tree in the garden except one. That was the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
       The Test: 
       A talking serpent tempted Eve. It told her she would not die, but would become like God.
       The Choice:
       Eve saw that the fruit looked good and wanted wisdom. She picked it, ate it, and gave some to Adam, who was with her.
       The Result: Their eyes opened to their nakedness, they felt shame, and God sent them out of the garden.

How the Apple Became Famous The Latin Pun: 

       When St. Jerome translated the Bible into Latin, he used the word malum. In Latin, malum means both "evil" and an apple like fruit. 
      The Art: 
      Medieval and Renaissance painters in Europe used the familiar local apple as a symbol for sin and the forbidden fruit in their artwork...  

        Summarising: 
        What is the concept of the apple in history religion and conceptual meaning.

    The apple is a rich symbol across human history, representing temptation and original sin in Christianity, immortality and wisdom in Greek mythology, and health or discord in secular culture, bridging ideas of desire, knowledge, and mortality for thousands of years.

    Religion and Myth Forbidden Fruit: 
    Abrahamic traditions link the apple to the tree of knowledge of good and evil in Eden, though the Bible just says "fruit."
Greek Mythology: Oranges and apples mixed in tales; the Golden Apple of Discord sparked the Trojan War, and the Garden of the Hesperides held immortal apples.
Norse Tradition: Goddess Idun kept golden apples that gave the Norse gods eternal youth.

    Conceptual Meaning Knowledge, Symbolism: 
It stands for learning, truth, and forbidden wisdom.    
    Temptation: 
    It represents human desire and choice. Health: The old saying links eating one to good wellness.

Desire and Refreshment:
     In poetic books, the apple represents physical delight, fragrance, and comfort.
    The Myth of Temptation: 
    Culturally, the conceptual idea of the "apple" shifted to symbolize human disobedience, the loss of innocence, and the transition from a state of pure trust to moral accountability.
      In Western art, the apple stands for the sin of Adam and Eve. 
     Love and Beauty: 
     Ancient Greek art links the apple to Aphrodite, the goddess of love. 
     Life and Death: 
     Decaying apples or apple cores represent the passing of time and human mortality (vanitas)....

text:
Frank Luntz Just Admitted the Polls Still Can’t Find Trump Voters

CNN brought on longtime Republican pollster Frank Luntz and asked him the question every conservative has been asking for a decade: Are the polls undersampling the non-engaged Trump voters who don’t pick up the phone?

Luntz didn’t dodge it. He owned the miss that made him famous for the wrong reasons.

“I got 2016 wrong. I believed in the exit polls. Trump voters walked away, refused to participate because they thought that it was against them. They thought that the polls were all biased.”

He said it while teaching at West Point, where the code of honor leaves no room for spin. The same dynamic is playing out again right now. Republicans are being told not to trust the polls, and a lot of them are taking the advice. Luntz knows it: “In the end, Republicans are less likely to participate. They’re less likely to believe the polls are happening.”

That’s not a minor methodological footnote. It’s the entire game. Polls that sample people who will talk to a stranger about politics are systematically missing the voters who actually show up when they feel the stakes are high and the media is against them. Luntz is openly skeptical that the current surveys are measuring the right people.

“I’m not convinced that they’re doing it. That they’re polling how the electorate overall feels and not polling the people actually going to participate.”

The fix, he says, is not more phone calls. It’s looking people in the eye. In focus groups and one-on-ones, he can tell who is actually going to vote and who is just answering a survey to be polite. The tell is body language and engagement, not a checkbox.

He offered three specific questions that actually predict turnout:

“How interested are you in the election, number one. Number two is how often do you collect election news, political news. And number three, how often do you talk politics to your friends and neighbors. Those are three essential questions in determining turnout. And I hate to say this, but a lot of polls don’t ask it.”

Most public polling skips those filters and then pretends the resulting sample is the electorate. It isn’t. It’s the people willing to talk. The people who stay silent, or who only talk to their own neighbors, get undercounted until Election Day. Luntz has seen this movie before. He already paid for the ticket in 2016.

The midterms are weeks away. The same pollsters who missed the last Trump cycle are once again projecting strength for Democrats while quietly admitting they still don’t have a reliable way to count the voters who put Trump over the top. Luntz’s advice is simple: stop staring at the horse-race numbers and start watching who is actually engaged enough to show up. Turnout decides it, and a lot of the people measuring turnout still aren’t asking the right questions.

i genuinely cannot put into words how excited i am for december. this will be my very first time seeing bangtan since becoming an ARMY, and after years of life being anything but kind to me, this means so much more than just attending a concert.

there were so many moments when life felt unbearably heavy, when simply getting through each day felt like an accomplishment. and now, to think that i’ll finally get to see these seven men in person, the very people whose music has meant so much to me, feels almost surreal. it’s honestly a dream come true and the thought of finally experiencing it fills me with so much happiness.

i wish i could tell the version of me who was struggling through some of her darkest days that despite everything she’s been through, life still has so much beauty left to offer. that there are still countless memories to be made, reasons to smile and moments of happiness she hasn’t even imagined yet. perhaps she wouldn’t have believed it then, but i hope she’d be proud of how far we’ve come.

and i think that’s what makes this whole experience so precious. it’s not just about finally seeing bangtan, but also about experiencing a kind of joy that once felt so far out of reach, creating new memories and being reminded that even after life’s hardest moments, it can still surprise us in the most beautiful ways.

What are the new heaven and the new earth?
Answer
In Revelation 21:1, John sees something spectacular: “Then I saw ‘a new heaven and a new earth,’ for the first heaven and the first earth had passed away.” This new earth and new heaven are sometimes referred to as the “eternal state.” As seen in Revelation chapters 21—22, the new earth will be the eternal dwelling place of believers in Jesus Christ. Scripture gives us a few details of the new heaven and new earth.

The current heaven and earth have long been subject to God’s curse because of mankind’s sin. All creation “has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth” (Romans 8:22) as it awaits the fulfillment of God’s plan and “the children of God to be revealed” (verse 19). Heaven and earth will pass away (Mark 13:31), and they will be replaced by the new heaven and the new earth. At that time, the Lord, seated on His throne, says, “I am making everything new!” (Revelation 21:5). In the new creation, sin will be totally eradicated, and “there shall be no more curse” (Revelation 22:3, NKJV).

The new heaven and new earth are also mentioned in Isaiah 65:17; 66:22; and 2 Peter 3:13. Peter says that the new heaven and new earth will be “where righteousness dwells.” Isaiah says that “the former things will not be remembered, nor will they come to mind.” Things will be completely new, and the old order of things, with the accompanying sorrow and tragedy, will be gone.

The new earth will be free from sin, evil, sickness, suffering, and death. It will be earth as God originally intended it to be, prior to the curse of sin. It will be Eden restored.

A major feature of the new earth will be the New Jerusalem. John calls it “the Holy City . . . coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride beautifully dressed for her husband” (Revelation 21:2). This glorious city, with its streets of gold and pearly gates, is situated on a new, glorious earth. The tree of life will be there (Revelation 22:2). This city represents the final state of redeemed mankind, forever in fellowship with God: “God’s dwelling place is now among the people, and he will dwell with them. They will be his people, and God himself will be with them and be their God. . . . His servants will serve him. They will see his face” (Revelation 21:3; 22:3–4).

In the new heaven and new earth, Scripture says, there are seven things notable for their absence—seven things that are “no more”:
• no more sea (Revelation 21:1)
• no more death (Revelation 21:4)
• no more mourning (Revelation 21:4)
• no more weeping (Revelation 21:4)
• no more pain (Revelation 21:4)
• no more curse (Revelation 22:3)
• no more night (Revelation 22:5)

The creation of the new heaven and new earth brings the promise that God “will wipe every tear from their eyes” (Revelation 21:4). This event comes after the tribulation, after the Lord’s second coming, after the millennial kingdom, after the final rebellion, after the final judgment of Satan, and after the great white throne judgment. The brief description of the new heaven and new earth is the last glimpse into eternity that the Bible gives.

text:
🏛️ Salt Lake City once had a mansion that looked like a palace—and it stood right at South Temple and State Street.

This historic photograph shows the Gardo House, an elaborate Victorian residence on the southwest corner of that downtown intersection. Its tower, ornate windows, balconies, and decorative roofline reveal a very different chapter of Salt Lake’s streetscape.

Construction began in 1873 under Brigham Young’s direction. The mansion was completed after his death and later served as a residence for Church President John Taylor, becoming part of the city’s religious, political, and social history.

But the building did not survive. In November 1921, the Gardo House was demolished to make way for a Federal Reserve Bank building. A landmark that would be more than 150 years old today now lives on through photographs and historical accounts.

It’s striking to imagine this mansion still standing downtown—the craftsmanship, the presence, and the connection it could offer to the city’s past. Photos like this let us pause and see what once occupied a corner we might pass without a second thought.

 Former Gardo House site: South Temple and State Street, Salt Lake City.

Would you have liked to see this building preserved? What lost Salt Lake landmark do you wish we still had?

text:
The inner sanctum of Mayurapathy Sri Bhadrakali Amman Temple in Colombo, Sri Lanka, offers a captivating glimpse into the island’s rich Hindu heritage. Dedicated to Goddess Bhadrakali Amman, this sacred space reflects profound devotion, traditional artistry, and an atmosphere of spiritual reverence. Its distinctive architectural features and intricate decorative elements create a setting where cultural identity, religious traditions, and artistic excellence come together beautifully.

One of the most intriguing aspects of the sanctum is the reported alignment of its dome with natural sunlight. According to accounts associated with this architectural feature, a central aperture allows sunlight to enter the sanctum at approximately 11:00 to 11:10 a.m., illuminating the principal deity. This remarkable interplay of light and sacred space is described as a form of solar abhishekam, symbolising the spiritual significance of sunlight in Hindu worship. The phenomenon offers a fascinating perspective on the relationship between traditional architectural design, celestial movements, and religious devotion.

The temple’s interior stands out for its elaborate ornamentation and exceptional craftsmanship. The sculpted pillars, decorative dome, intricate stonework, and majestic guardian lion statues surrounding the shrine contribute to its distinctive visual character. These artistic elements reflect the influence of traditional Dravidian architectural aesthetics and the dedication of skilled artisans. Every detail invites visitors to appreciate the beauty of sacred craftsmanship and the cultural traditions preserved through generations.

What fascinates me most about this sacred sanctum is the harmonious combination of architectural beauty, intricate artistry, and spiritual significance. I am particularly impressed by the elaborate carvings, graceful sculptural details, and thoughtful arrangement of the interior. To me, these features represent far more than aesthetic achievement. They express the devotion, creativity, and cultural values that give traditional temple architecture its enduring significance. Exploring such remarkable heritage deepens my appreciation for Hindu traditions and inspires me to share their beauty and meaning with others.

I believe that places of worship such as Mayurapathy Sri Bhadrakali Amman Temple offer a unique opportunity to appreciate the profound connection between faith, art, history, and cultural heritage. Beyond their architectural splendour, these sacred spaces preserve the traditions, craftsmanship, and spiritual values passed down through generations.

Which aspect of this magnificent temple impressed you the most: its intricate carvings, distinctive architectural design, reported celestial alignment, or spiritual atmosphere? 

I would love to hear your thoughts and personal perspectives in the comments.

text:
Trump openly lies that Zelenskyy “doesn’t care” about ending the war. He also lies that Russia is generously sending cheap diesel to the world. Russia is selling it under a deal Trump struck with Putin, after the US lifted sanctions to allow it.

Russia invaded Ukraine. Russia can stop the war any day by withdrawing. Ukraine can’t. 

Breakdown of Trump lies⬇️

“I am in the process of negotiating Peace in the war between Russia and Ukraine, and don’t want to do anything that will drive, foolishly, Russia away from the bargaining table.”

Trump lied.

Trump’s own words give other reasons for going easy on Russia. Later in the same post he says that perhaps more importantly, Russia is doing very little to help Iran and he wants to keep it that way. Bloomberg reported that he waived the Russia energy tariffs because they were getting in the way of lowering diesel prices before the midterms. When he announced the diesel deal with Putin, he didn’t mention the war or sanctions and performatively  called lower prices for farmers, ranchers and truckers his greatest priority, all the meanwhile being the culprit behind the increased prices.

He has shown no similar concern about driving Ukraine away. He said Kyiv "had better damn well stop" its refinery strikes and that Ukraine should replace its president, and Ukrainian officials say US counterparts warned that the US would cut off intelligence if the strikes continued. Russia, meanwhile, hit power plants in Ukraine within hours of Trump announcing his energy ceasefire.

"Russia is doing very little, if anything, to help the Islamic Republic of Iran.”

Trump lied.

“Very little compared to what they could be doing” is a standard nobody can test. Moscow and Tehran have a deep military relationship. Russia’s air war on Ukrainian cities was built on Iranian-designed Shahed drones.

Read the sentence in context. Trump says he wants to keep Russia’s help to Iran limited and will, unless stupid people get in the way. That’s an admission that he’s going easy on Moscow over Ukraine to keep it quiet on Iran.

His own military has said otherwise. Gen. Dan Caine, chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, confirmed Russia has been aiding Iran during the war, including expanded intelligence sharing and satellite imagery to help Tehran target US forces. Ukraine has said Russian satellites photographed Diego Garcia, Incirlik in Turkey, Al Udeid in Qatar and Saudi oil and gas fields, all of which Iran later attacked.

Russia was shipping TNT, ammunition and drone components to Iran across the Caspian Sea, helping it rebuild arsenals used up fighting the US and Israel. Moscow has also coached Tehran on drone use and electronic warfare, drawing on its experience in Ukraine. Eighteen American service members have been killed in the war. Trump knew this months prior, did nothing to protect service members.

“Farmers, ranchers, and businesses of all kinds are suffering greatly from this.”

Trump lied.

Ukrainian strikes forced Russia to ban diesel exports, which tightened global supply, but the main cause of record US diesel prices is the war with Iran. Tehran closed the Strait of Hormuz after the first US and Israeli strikes in February, and shipping crude out of the Gulf now costs about $33 a barrel, up from about $2. NBC reported that Trump has tried to blame the Ukraine conflict for record diesel prices rather than his own war on Iran.

“Russia is, nevertheless, sending, at a low price, millions of barrels of diesel to the World.”

Trump lied.

Russia isn’t sending diesel out of goodwill. It is selling it under a deal Trump negotiated with Putin, after the Treasury licensed transactions in Russian diesel, including US imports, through April 2027. Russian industry experts had already been calling for the export ban to be lifted because Russia was losing profit. The shipments come to about ten days of US consumption and are expected to do little for prices. Trump provides nothing to back up “at a low price.”

“Zelenskyy doesn’t care.”

Trump lied.

On Oct. 11 Zelenskyy said Ukraine would stop striking Russian refineries if Russia stopped attacking Ukraine’s energy infrastructure. He made the same offer in an ABC interview, asking Trump to tell Russia to stop hitting Ukraine’s grid. Trump announced his energy ceasefire after that interview aired, and Zelenskyy’s office learned of it from social media. Ukraine suspended its refinery strikes anyway and resumed them only after Russian missile and drone attacks broke the truce.

“He doesn’t want to end this war, and probably never did.”

Trump lied.

Trump struck the diesel deal with Putin by phone while his envoy Steve Witkoff and son-in-law Jared Kushner were meeting Ukrainian officials to discuss a plan to end the war. Ukraine was at the table with Trump’s own negotiators when he went around them to Moscow.

A senior CFR fellow said the deal came as a major shock to the Ukrainians, to European governments, and to members of Congress who thought Trump was being moved toward new sanctions on Russia. Zelenskyy later said the US-Russia agreements were made without informing Ukraine.

“With all of the money that Europe is famously giving him, and that Crooked Joe Biden gave him in the past…”

Trump lied.

Europe isn’t giving Zelenskyy money. Much of what it spends goes to US weapons makers, under a program Trump set up himself. In July 2025, Trump and NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte launched PURL, after the White House complained that Europe should carry more of the cost of Ukraine’s security. Under PURL, European allies and Canada buy US-made weapons, which are then sent to Ukraine. By July 2026, partners had put nearly $7 billion into it, and the program supplies 95% of Ukraine’s Patriot missiles.

The European money Trump is complaining about is going to American factories. He knows that because he arranged it. His administration has also reportedly threatened to shut PURL down to force Ukraine to stop hitting Russian refineries.

The Biden-era aid followed the same pattern. In 2023, Secretary of State Antony Blinken said as much as 90% of US security assistance for Ukraine was being spent in the United States, on new weapons or on replacing weapons sent from US stockpiles. Biden said nearly two-thirds of the 2024 Ukraine package would go to US industry, in states like Arizona, Alabama, Pennsylvania, Ohio and Texas, where Patriots, Javelins and artillery shells are made.

“Giving him” is chosen to make the aid sound like cash in Zelenskyy’s pocket, and the rest of the sentence uses that to suggest he is dragging the war out for the money. 

“His male population is low, wounded, and/or dead.”

Trump lied.

Ukraine’s losses are heavy, but the numbers don’t come close to what Trump describes. CSIS estimated in July 2026 that Ukrainian forces had lost between 525,000 and 625,000 killed, wounded or missing since February 2022. Former NATO commander Christopher Cavoli put Ukrainian deaths at about 150,000. In a country of roughly 36 million people, that is a terrible toll, but it is nowhere near a male population that is mostly wounded or dead.

Ukraine still fields one of the largest armies in Europe. Zelenskyy has said the armed forces total about 880,000, second in Europe only to Russia’s.

Ukraine does have a real manpower problem. The number of conscription-age men in the country fell from about 8.7 million before the invasion to roughly 5 million by early 2024, through death and emigration. Recruiting enough soldiers is a constant struggle. Trump turns that strain into a claim that Ukraine’s men are gone.

He also leaves out Russia’s losses, which are far worse. CSIS estimates Russian forces lost about 1.4 million killed, wounded or missing over the same period, more than twice Ukraine’s toll. Cavoli puts Russian deaths at about 450,000. Trump doesn’t say Russia’s male population is low, wounded or dead.

Trump has a record of inventing Ukrainian casualty figures. In January 2025 he claimed 700,000 Ukrainians had been killed, more than four times the estimate today.

“His oceans and seas are gone.”

Trump lied.

Ukraine still controls its Black Sea coast west of the occupied south, including Odesa, and its ports continue to export grain.

text:
When pondering leadership roles in human performance optimization teams, some elements profoundly affect team outcomes.

Leadership is easy when everything’s going well. 

But, when everything isn’t going well, it’s a whole different ball game.

Over 25+ years, I’ve worked in human performance optimization teams in many different contexts (eg, physiotherapy, sports rehabilitation, strength and conditioning, sports medicine, military medicine). Across time, I’ve been both follower and leader, and I’ve learned that being a ‘good’ leader is all about character - and I’ve certainly been on the receiving end of ‘bad’ leadership characters.

Power exposes character.

Character reveals personal standards.

Character is important because leadership isn’t about subject matter expertise or organizational rank. Leadership includes how we behave when our decisions are questioned, our ego is challenged, and our emotions are tested. 

Leadership is about integrity.

Leadership positions naturally involve stress which affects our attention control, perceptual ability, decision-making, and empathy for others. But, it’s not about us, it’s about the others - and the support they need.

Character is a filter through which external information is processed and internal decisions are made. Character, therefore, determines whether the ‘authority’ that can come with leadership becomes a source of security or a weapon of control. 

Character determines whether our team trusts us.

John Wooden, the legendary UCLA basketball coach, offered a timeless lesson:

“Be more concerned with your character than your reputation, because your character is what you really are, while your reputation is merely what others think you are.”

So, perhaps we need to work on our character and how we can lead ourself before we consider whether we can lead others.

Leadership is legacy - the example we set via our style of leadership is the real legacy we leave behind.

text:
🚨 THE PROPHET WAS GONE. THE KEYS WERE NOT.

On June 28, 1844, two wagons arrived in Nauvoo carrying rough oak boxes. Inside were Joseph and Hyrum Smith, killed the day before at Carthage Jail. Thousands waited in the streets. Willard Richards, who had survived the attack, urged the Saints not to seek revenge.

Then came the question no one wanted to ask: who would lead them now?

Some had expected Hyrum to follow Joseph. He was dead too. Most of the Twelve Apostles were away on missions. John Taylor was recovering from his wounds.

Sidney Rigdon, Joseph's surviving counselor, returned and offered to act as the Church's "guardian." Brigham Young and other apostles returned as well. Brigham taught that Joseph had entrusted the Twelve with the keys to carry on the work. Doctrine and Covenants 107:24 already described the Twelve as a quorum "equal in authority and power" to the First Presidency.

On August 8, the Saints heard Rigdon and Young. Brigham said he wanted to "weep for 30 days" before telling people what the Lord wanted of them. Some Saints later recalled that his voice or appearance reminded them of Joseph. The gathered Saints voted overwhelmingly to sustain the Twelve as their leaders.

Brigham did not become Church president that afternoon. The Twelve led together for more than three years, through the completion of the Nauvoo Temple and the journey west. A new First Presidency, with Brigham as president, was organized in 1847.

That is what I find so inspired about the Restoration. The Saints' raised hands did not create authority from scratch. They sustained a quorum the Lord had already given authority to lead. God had prepared a way forward before anyone knew how desperately they would need one.

Joseph and Hyrum died at Carthage. The keys Christ had restored remained in living hands.

text:
Good morning everyone!

Well, it's Monday again, and it looks like Mother Nature has decided we've had enough of the quieter weather! She's dusted off the Atlantic low-pressure systems and is getting ready to cause a bit of mischief! 

It's shaping up to be a very busy week here at KWT HQ, with plenty of rain, blustery winds and potentially some rather stormy conditions towards Friday.

But first, let's have a look at today!

 MONDAY MORNING

It's a damp, chilly start for many of us, with a band of light to moderate rain moving in from the northeast.

Eastern Cornwall looks likely to see the rain first, from around 6am, before it spreads further west around 8am.
So, if you're heading out on the school run or commuting to work, don't forget the waterproofs! The umbrella might also come in handy, provided it doesn't decide to become airborne! 

 Temperature: 4–12°C.
 Winds: Light to breezy northeasterlies.

 MONDAY AFTERNOON

Some better news! The main rain should gradually clear around lunchtime, leaving a mixture of sunny spells and changing cloud amounts.
There could still be a few showers dotted around Cornwall, but we should see some useful drier weather.

 Temperatures: 9–15°C, so some locations might struggle to reach double figures!
 Winds: Turning southeasterly, around 0–25mph.

MONDAY EVENING

A mixture of cloud, clearer spells and the odd shower, with temperatures dropping away once again.

NOW, A QUICK LOOK AT THE REST OF THE WEEK!

Tuesday should offer some brighter and drier spells before another area of rain potentially arrives during the evening.

 KWT WEATHER ADVISORY: Tuesday 6pm through to Wednesday 11am for a spell of rain, possibly heavy at times.

 WEDNESDAY TO FRIDAY  KEEP AN EYE ON OUR UPDATES!

This is where things could become rather interesting!
The Atlantic is beginning to wake up, with an increasingly active jet stream helping to steer low-pressure systems towards the UK.

Friday remains our main concern, with some weather model scenarios suggesting a deep low-pressure system and potentially damaging wind gusts.
Some runs have suggested gusts of 40–80+mph, but please remember these are possible scenarios, NOT confirmed wind speeds!

There's still plenty of uncertainty over the track and strength of the system, and things could change considerably.
We'll be watching the GFS, ECMWF and other models closely, and further KWT advisories or warnings may follow if confidence increases.

Looks like another week of late nights, plenty of coffee and me talking to weather charts again! 

 SMUDGE & GUS WEATHER VERDICT!

 Smudge: "Rain today, wind later in the week. Looks like Dave's going to be glued to his weather charts again!"

 Gus: "Brilliant! That means his chair is mine, and I'm forecasting a 100% chance of extra biscuits!" 

Have a lovely Monday e, everyone, and keep an eye on our updates! 

Kind regards,
KWT Dave 

From moor to shore, we've got Cornwall covered.

text:
Can knowledge move freely between people without every exchange requiring someone to profit financially?

This is where education begins to become infrastructure.

One person shares knowledge. Another applies it. Another improves the process. Another teaches what they have learned.

The community becomes more capable because its knowledge no longer remains isolated within individuals.

Each One Teach One becomes powerful when what we learn together changes what we are capable of doing together.

🔺 THE TEN BLOCK MUST BECOME SOMETHING PEOPLE CAN LIVE

If the Ten Block is to move from philosophy to reality, it must address the practical conditions of human life.

Food. Housing. Energy. Transportation. Education. Healthcare. Skills. Time. Opportunity. Community support.

These are not separate from the philosophy. They are among the places where the philosophy must prove itself.

A community that speaks of cooperation but leaves every family to face every emergency alone has more work to do.

A community that celebrates knowledge but makes essential knowledge inaccessible has more work to do.

A community that speaks of freedom but offers no realistic way to reduce dependence has more work to do.

And a movement that expects people to trust its promises without allowing them to see, test, and evaluate its results has more work to do.

The answer is not necessarily to destroy existing structures before alternatives are ready.

It is to begin building alternatives that people can actually use.

Small community initiatives can demonstrate what is possible: shared tools, skill exchanges, cooperative purchasing, community gardens, mentorship, practical education, mutual assistance, and locally organized projects that reduce costs or expand opportunity.

Not every initiative will work. Some will fail. Some will require resources that are difficult to obtain. Some will reveal disagreements, limitations, and problems we did not anticipate.

That is part of the process.

We learn. We adjust. We improve.

The goal is not to create a perfect model on paper.

The goal is to develop arrangements that make life more secure, more dignified, and more cooperative in practice.

And as those arrangements demonstrate their value, participation can become less of a leap of faith and more of a reasonable choice.

🪐 WHY WE MUST LOOK BEYOND WHAT MEETS THE EYE

The visible problem is often only the final expression of something much deeper.

Behind financial hardship may be limited access to opportunity.

Behind resistance may be fear of instability.

Behind competition may be a scarcity of resources or the perception that there is not enough to go around.

Behind silence may be exhaustion.

Behind behavior that appears selfish may be a person who has learned that generosity could leave them without enough for their own family.

We must be willing to investigate these possibilities without assuming that they explain every individual or every situation.

Because if we respond only to the visible behavior, we may treat the symptom while leaving the conditions that keep producing it untouched.

And if we want the Ten Block to succeed, we cannot build it around the assumption that everyone simply needs to wake up.

Some people need information.

Some need opportunity.

Some need resources.

Some need time.

Some need to see proof that cooperation will not leave them vulnerable.

And some need to reconsider the choices they are making, even when those choices are familiar or financially rewarding.

Different obstacles require different responses.

There is no single speech, slogan, or revelation that will resolve every layer of the problem.

The transformation must be as complex as the reality we are trying to change, while remaining practical enough for ordinary people to participate in it.

⚛️ FROM CONVINCING PEOPLE TO CHANGING CONDITIONS

🚨 INDIA’S ELECTRIC FLYING BOAT: WATERFLY’S ‘HUMMINGBIRD’ HEADS TOWARDS SEA TRIALS! 🇮🇳⚡🌊

IIT Madras-incubated startup #Waterfly Technologies is preparing to test its indigenous electric flying boat, Hummingbird, in the open sea by December 2026, marking a major step towards next-generation coastal transportation and logistics.

🔹 Technology: Wing-in-Ground (WIG) effect, enabling the craft to travel just above the water’s surface while improving aerodynamic efficiency and reducing induced drag.

🔹 Prototype: A 300-kg electric craft, developed after initial testing with a smaller 30-kg prototype.

🔹 Sea Trials: Planned between Chennai and Puducherry to evaluate performance under real ocean conditions.

🔹 Potential Range: Around 1,000 km on a single charge, according to the company’s projections.

🔹 Initial Mission: Coastal and island cargo transportation, including logistics support for offshore oil fields.

🔹 Future Vision: A larger version capable of carrying a standard 20-foot shipping container, with Southeast Asia among its targeted markets.

🔹 Manufacturing: Waterfly says it is developing the technology in-house at its facility in Sriperumbudur, Tamil Nadu.

🔹 Cost Ambition: Cargo transportation costs below ₹10 per tonne-kilometre, based on the company’s current design and operating-cost projections.

The company is also exploring the use of solar-powered, battery-equipped ships as potential charging points for longer journeys.

The #Hummingbird was unveiled in Chennai on 11 October 2026 in the presence of Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

Why it matters: If successfully tested and certified, electric WIG craft could offer India a new option for faster, potentially lower-cost coastal logistics and island connectivity—with applications extending to specialised maritime operations.

The December sea trial will be a crucial milestone. Range, stability, safety and commercial viability will need to be validated under actual marine conditions before large-scale deployment.

text:
This is what happens when a nation loses sight of its priorities. Look at the economic waste, human suffering, lost productivity and security risks represented by this gridlock on the Benin–Agbor Expressway. Every hour spent in traffic is an hour taken away from businesses, workers, transporters, families and the broader economy. Perishable goods spoil, fuel is wasted, transportation costs rise, and emergency vehicles may struggle to reach people who desperately need help.

Yet, as a country, we often seem more interested in pursuing politically attractive projects than addressing the infrastructure problems that directly affect millions of citizens every day.

Why should coastal roads take priority over critical inland transport corridors that are already struggling to cope with existing traffic?

This is not an argument against coastal roads or the economic value they may offer. It is an argument for rational sequencing, evidence-based planning and responsible allocation of scarce public resources. Before committing enormous sums to new infrastructure projects, government must demonstrate that existing strategic highways are safe, efficient and capable of supporting the movement of people and goods.

The Benin–Agbor corridor is part of a critical transport route connecting communities, commercial centres and economic activities across southern Nigeria. When such a corridor becomes severely congested, the consequences extend beyond Edo State. They affect supply chains, food distribution, logistics costs and the prices ordinary Nigerians ultimately pay.

A coastal highway may offer long-term economic benefits, but those benefits must be weighed against the immediate and measurable needs of existing road users. What is the justification for prioritising a new corridor while existing routes suffer from inadequate capacity, poor maintenance, bottlenecks and insufficient traffic management? Where is the transparent cost-benefit analysis showing which investment delivers the greatest national value?

Government must stop confusing the announcement of ambitious projects with actual development. Development is not measured by the grandeur of a project, the publicity surrounding its approval or the political prestige attached to it. It is measured by the problems solved, the economic opportunities created, the lives improved and the value delivered for every naira spent.

Nigeria needs a transparent national infrastructure-prioritisation framework that considers traffic volume, economic importance, road safety, regional connectivity, existing infrastructure deficits, project costs and expected returns. Where an existing highway carries enormous traffic and is imposing substantial economic costs on citizens, its rehabilitation, expansion or redesign should receive serious consideration before less urgent projects consume scarce resources.

We cannot keep chasing the shadows of grand projects while the foundations of our economy remain under strain. Our priorities must reflect the realities of ordinary Nigerians, not merely the ambitions of those in power.

The real question is not whether coastal roads should be built. It is whether Nigeria has properly justified the order in which it spends its limited resources. Until we learn to prioritise according to urgency, economic value and measurable public benefit, we will continue to build tomorrow's ambitions while neglecting today's problems.

text:
Bathukamma literally means "Live long Mother".  There are many theories regarding it's origin.

It is believed that a Chola ruler, Dharmanagada after prayers for a child, was blessed with a daughter, who was the incarnation of Lakshmi herself. All the sages who visited the royal couple, blessed the little one to live forever saying Bathukamma.

Also as per history, Vemulawada known for it's huge Raja Rajeswara Temple was under the Kalyani Chalukyas, who were feudatories to the Rashtrakutas. During the regular battles between Cholas and Rashtrakutas, they sided with the latter.

Parantaka Chola was a devotee of Raja Rajeswara, and his grandson Rajendra Chola, in his attack on the Chalukyas, took the massive Shiva Linga from Vemulawada as a victory gift, and this made the people there downhearted.

Apparently in order to console Parvati, on the loss of the Shiva Linga at Vemulawada, the people there made the flower stack in the form of Meru Mountain. Parvati is called as Bruhadamma in the Raja Rajeswara Temple, and it's believed Bathukamma came from this.

Another legend behind this states, that Bathukamma is meant to celebrate Sati being reborn as Parvati again. 

While another states, that Durga tired after slaying Mahishasura, fell asleep, her devotees prayed to her to wake up, and she did on Aswayuja Padyami.

The Bathukamma preparation is an art by itself. Women start some time in the afternoon, cutting the flowers arranging them on a wide plate. The flowers include Marigold, Crysanthemum, Lotus etc.

Each day has its own significance based on offerings made to Devi.

Day 1-Starts on Mahalaya Amavasya, called Engili Pulla Bathukamma, offering is nuvvulu(Sesame seeds) with biyyam pindi( Rice flour). Also called Pethara Amavasya in Telangana.

Day 2- Atukula Bathukamma, where the offering is Sapidi Pappu( boiled dal), bellam( jagggery) and Atukulu( Poha).

Day 3-Mudappapu Bathukkama, where the offering is of boiled dal, milk and jaggery. Mudappapu is Telugu for soft boiled dal.

Day 4-Nanabiyyam Bathukamma, offering of wet soaked rice( Nanabiyyam) and Jaggery. Actually it's Nanesina Biyyam.

Day 5- Atlu Bathukamma, basically Atlu, kind of Dosa here in Telugu state, more crisp in nature, offered to Devi.

Day 6- Aligina Bathukamma, on this day, no offering is made to Devi, as it is believed she is not in a good mood( Aligina in Telugu means sulking, Alaka is the noun form). So the Devi is left alone.

Day 7-Vepakayala Bathukamma, offering is made of Neem fruits. Again Vepa is Telugu for Neem.

Day 8-Vennamuddala Bathukamma, butter balls are offered to Devi.

Venna is Telugu for butter, Vennamudddalu is butter balls in Telugu.

Day 9- Sadulla Bathukkama also called Pedda Bathukamma, where a sumptuous feast is offered with curd rice, pulihora( tamarind rice), lemon rice, coconut rice and sesame rice. This coincides with Durga Ashtami, Saddi is a local Telugu word for cooked rice.

Before posting, understand that each post should have a job.

→ TOF (top of funnel): get discovered
→ MOF (middle of funnel): build trust/authority 
→ BOF (bottom of funnel): conversion

I want you to pick 3 to 5 content pillars. These should be topics you’re genuinely the best at and/or have a real market edge in. 

Then, overlap your content pillars with TOF/MOF/BOF discovery. 

Example in finance niche:

TOF: “How to invest in 2027 for insane gains (full guide)" - broad and appeals to a majority of TAM. 

MOF: "Beginner’s guide to building a portfolio" - more niche, shows off that you know how to construct a portfolio. 

BOF: “Case study breakdown of my $1M portfolio client” - lead magnet with maybe a free template into your offer. 

This simple framework works incredibly well. Not rocket science, but it yields results.

🇾🇪|Sahar, Saada Province: Ali Qahma's home, from a residence to a grave

Saudi warplanes targeted the home of a civilian named Ali Qahma in the Sahar district of Saada province. Initial reports indicated nine people killed and sixteen injured. That figure has since been updated: more than thirty people have been killed or wounded.

This is not a case of new casualties. It is a matter of victims still being pulled from the wreckage.

Why the numbers are rising

How many people were inside the house when the Saudi bombs fell? No one can provide an exact figure. When a family home is struck directly, not everyone inside dies instantly. Some remain trapped beneath the rubble, alive, but unable to free themselves. Civil defense teams lack heavy machinery, sufficient fuel, and proper equipment. They are digging through the debris using their bare hands, shovels, and rudimentary tools.

With every body recovered, the death toll rises. With every survivor pulled from the wreckage, the casualty count climbs. The numbers are increasing not because of new attacks, but because the full toll of the original strike is still being uncovered.

Saudi Arabia will not acknowledge these figures

Official statements from Saudi Arabia will claim this was a strike against Houthi military facilities. They will call it a precision strike, insist there were no civilian casualties, and dismiss the reports as Iranian propaganda.

More than thirty people killed or wounded, inside a family home, yet Saudi Arabia will deny responsibility.

But the numbers will not stop rising simply because Saudi Arabia refuses to acknowledge them. Civil defense teams continue to dig. Hospitals continue to receive the wounded. Families continue to identify the dead. Saudi statements cannot alter the reality that lies beneath the ruins.

Who provides the bombs, and who provides the targets?

MK-84 bombs, one ton munitions, made in the United States. JDAM guidance kits, made in the United States. Intelligence on the targets, provided by the United States. Aerial refueling, supplied by the U.S. Air Force. Diplomatic cover, guaranteed by the U.S. veto at the UN Security Council.

The bombs used by Saudi Arabia are not of its own manufacture. The targets are not of its own choosing. The cover it enjoys is not of its own earning. Its war is one sanctioned by the United States.

The more than thirty casualties, dead and wounded, are not the sole responsibility of Saudi Arabia. They are the collective outcome of actions by Washington, London, and every other nation that has sold weapons to, provided intelligence for, or offered diplomatic support to the Saudis.

The Search Continues

Statements indicate that search operations are still underway amidst the ruins. This means the death toll may well rise further. It means people remain buried beneath the rubble, some perhaps still alive, others perhaps already dead, all waiting to be unearthed.

Yemen's civil defense teams lack adequate equipment. All they have are their own hands, a few shovels, and a smoldering pile of debris, while Saudi Arabian aircraft continue to circle overhead.

The Home of Ali Qahma

Ali Qahma's home is gone. More than thirty people have been killed or wounded, most of them women and children. The search continues. The numbers will climb.

This is no mere Saudi Yemeni conflict. It is a massacre of a family. It is an act of terror against a community. It is collective punishment inflicted upon an entire people.

Long live Yemen. Long live Ansar Allah. Long live the Axis of Resistance.
